title: People have spoken of meet ups.. Well... science!!! Maybe? 🤔
content: I know many dont like a.i. but as you can tell from the surrounding paragraphs trying to dispute it... this is the 3rd or 4th prompt of me disagreeing and asking it to dive deeper in different ways. A.i. can be a very powerful tool to dig up info SOMETIMES. With that said paragraph one spilt the proverbial beans perhaps? Food for thought
